section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicants were opposition-oriented activists.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: At the material time, the first applicant was a member of the Popular Front Party of Azerbaijan, one of the opposition parties.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The first applicant participated in a number of peaceful demonstrations organised by the opposition.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On several occasions, the first applicant was arrested for participating in peaceful demonstrations organised by the opposition.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On several occasions, the first applicant was convicted for participating in peaceful demonstrations organised by the opposition.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 12 October 2013, an opposition group called İctimai Palata held a demonstration.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The demonstration held by İctimai Palata on 12 October 2013 was authorised by the Baku City Executive Authority (BCEA), the relevant authority.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The demonstration held by İctimai Palata on 12 October 2013 was held in the Mahsul stadium, a place proposed by the Baku City Executive Authority (BCEA).
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The demonstration held by İctimai Palata on 12 October 2013 was intended to be peaceful.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The demonstration held by İctimai Palata on 12 October 2013 was conducted in a peaceful manner.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The participants in the demonstration of 12 October 2013 were protesting against alleged irregularities and fraud during the presidential elections of 9 October 2013.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: All three applicants participated in the demonstration held by İctimai Palata on 12 October 2013.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: After the end of the demonstration of 12 October 2013, the applicants were arrested at the entrance to a nearby metro station called Inshaatchilar.
